newsitem.title: USA: EchoCath says sees continued losses in Q3.
newsitem.headline: EchoCath says sees continued losses in Q3.

text.p: EchoCath Inc said Thursday it expects to report continued losses when it announces results for its fiscal third quarter and nine months ended May 31.
The company said, however, that the third quarter was the first time it generated revenue from product sales of its ultrasound technology.
The company said its revenues for the third quarter were about $142,000, which resulted from the shipment of its ColorMark system.

Revenues for this year's nine-month period were about $305,000, compared with $38,449 during the same nine-month period last year, and were derived from initial orders for the company's ColorMark system and licensing fees for EchoCath technology.
The company said it expects product sales, in conjunction with additional licensing fees, to increase incrementally from quarter to quarter.
EchoCath makes and sells medical devices which that use ultrasound technology for medical procedures.
